name: summary
description: A line of labeled values like the summary area of top, e.g. "%Cpu(s):  5.9 us,  2.0 sy, 91.8 id".

config.name: items
config.label: Values
config.description: One entry per value in the line

config.name: label
config.label: Label
config.description: The short name next to the value, e.g. "us" or "total". Defaults to the metric name

config.name: title
config.label: Title
config.description: The text at the start of the line, e.g. "%Cpu(s):" or "MiB Mem :"

config.name: title_width
config.label: Title Width
config.description: The minimum width of the title in characters. Give stacked lines the same width so their values line up

config.name: label_position
config.label: Labels
config.description: Where the label of each value goes. top puts it after the value

config.name: separator
config.label: Separator
config.description: The text between two values. Defaults to ", "

config.name: value_width
config.label: Value Width
config.description: The minimum width of each value in characters. Values are right aligned, so they stay in place while they change

config.name: bold_values
config.label: Bold Values
config.description: Draws the values in bold like top

config.name: hide_unit
config.label: Hide Unit
config.description: Shows the values without their units, like top

config.name: precision
config.label: Precision
config.description: The number of decimal places. If not set, it is chosen based on the value

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: Use a monospace font for the best result. Defaults to Cascadia Mono, Consolas or the system monospace font

config.name: font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size in pixels. The text shrinks when it does not fit the widget

config.name: theme
config.label: Theme
config.description: Color uses the htop and btop palette. Monochrome draws everything in one text color with reverse video headers, like plain top. Colors you set yourself are kept

config.name: text_color
config.label: Labels
config.description: The color of the labels and separators

config.name: background_color
config.label: Background
config.description: The background color of the widget
